services.name: Solo Safaris
services.desc: Kenya, the birthplace of the safari, offers unrivaled wildlife, iconic landscapes, and luxury lodges for year-round safari adventures. A Kenya safari immerses travelers in East Africa’s legendary landscapes, evoking iconic “Out of Africa” vistas. Maasai Mara offers the drama of the Great Migration and abundant predators, Laikipia’s private conservancies provide safe havens for elephants and rhinos, Samburu showcases unique northern wildlife amid arid landscapes, and Amboseli presents majestic elephants set against Mount Kilimanjaro. Guided game drives, walking safaris, sundowners, and luxury lodges complete the classic safari experience. Where to Stay: A Kenya safari offers luxurious lodges

blurb: African Travel, Inc. crafts personalized luxury safaris across Africa's iconic destinations. Guests experience wildlife, landscapes, and culture with expert local guides and VIP services. Safaris include tailor-made, escorted, and locally hosted journeys.
